scope: Substantive release evidence checklist, not legal clearance; blocking defects are separate from deferred provenance risks
blockers: Eight NPM package locations lack applicable full legal texts and no actual-bundle evidence places them outside the release payload: @humanfs/types 0.15.0, @napi-rs/wasm-runtime 1.2.6, @rolldown/binding-win32-x64-msvc 1.2.19, @tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi 4.3.5, nested @napi-rs/wasm-runtime 1.2.2 and @tybys/wasm-util 0.10.3, natural-compare 1.4.0, saxes 6.0.0

Actual three-target native compiler, CGO support-library and runtime legal texts are not yet reconciled with the emitted binaries, and no per-target evidence confirms that the bundled Web assets and the prebuilt WASI payload's applicable notices are present in the release payload

MPL-2.0 corresponding source access is recorded only as upstream locations; covered-source correspondence, local modifications and any required modified-source delivery for the actual release build remain unverified

deferred.risk: The embedded AVIF v0.6.0 prebuilt WASM is bound only by payload and recipe hashes; its exact upstream libavif/AOM/dav1d/libyuv revisions, WASI SDK/compiler/runtime inputs and any source modifications are unmapped. Payload presence and recorded legal texts are not provenance.
No reproducible-build or signed-attestation record ties the published binaries to the recorded source inputs and toolchain.
